headline_status_note: headline_status is the single most-actionable status across all OS/SKU lineages (see issue #39, F7), a cross-lineage triage summary -- NOT the status for any specific SKU. To answer a (SKU, CVE) question read the matching packages[].status row for that release, not headline_status.

packages.statement: Trivy reports the bundled module google.golang.org/grpc as fixed in 1.82.1. That is a fix in the module, not a rebuilt Azure CNI: this CVE clears only once Azure CNI is rebuilt against the patched module and a scanned VHD build ships that rebuild. No such build has been observed, so this stays 'affected'.
